name: Quiver hub
author: c-wenlong
description: Quiver's remote-control hub (swe remote serve): the phone PWA for watching and steering coding-agent sessions, with an inbox and a Usage tab, and the hub MacBook satellites dial. Pinned uv install under ~/.local/share/quiver-hub, systemd user unit, loopback-only behind Serve on :8477. Runs with --public-url, so 'Pair with Tailscale' works behind Serve; approve the code on the box with swe remote devices --approve. services/quiver-hub/pair.sh mints a token for satellites.
